title: Каньон резонанса
description: A connected twin-height floating limestone mesa with a deep central cleft, one broad gently arched stone bridge across the northern part of the cleft, a solid natural front land bridge, and three large bronze resonance pipes on the northeastern plateau. A cypress pair and golden grass on the west. The broad continuous road skirts the cleft and crosses the northern bridge on a gradual arc with no right-angle approaches.
